articles.title_en: Austrian opposition slams EU’s actions against Russia as totalitarian
articles.lead_en: According to Herbert Kickl, after the economic war against Russia "turned into a disaster and backfired on European citizens," Brussels is "resorting to a cancel culture at the state level"

articles.title_en: Founders of major Russian pet store chain killed in Chile after tourist minibus collides with truck. One driver fell asleep at the wheel, the other tested positive for cocaine.
articles.lead_en: Andrey and Marina Tsypin, founders of the pet store chain Chetyre Lapy (“Four Paws”), died in a car accident in Chile, media reported. The Chilean outlet La Prensa Austral reported the names of the deceased, as did the Telegram channels Shot and Baza.
